meta.title: Many-Layered Binding
meta.description: The pressure returns and the repeated impacts bear testament to the harshness of the battle conditions.

units.rawText: Null Area, inside backup communications node 4.
units.displayText: Null Area, inside backup communications node 4.

spans.text: Null Area, inside backup communications node 4.

units.rawText: I'm here.
units.displayText: I'm here.

spans.text: I'm here.

units.rawText: Inside the dilapidated structure, Entropic liquid slinks inwards along doorways and corners. In the deeper darkness, the self-proclaimed Ptolemaea awaits, reticent.
units.displayText: Inside the dilapidated structure, Entropic liquid slinks inwards along doorways and corners. In the deeper darkness, the self-proclaimed Ptolemaea awaits, reticent.

spans.text: Inside the dilapidated structure, Entropic liquid slinks inwards along doorways and corners. In the deeper darkness, the self-proclaimed Ptolemaea awaits, reticent.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Don't be so distant. Come closer.</color>
units.displayText: Don't be so distant. Come closer.

spans.text: Don't be so distant. Come closer.

units.rawText: What a cursed past few days it's been; all the Entropics I've seen seem to be playing at sophistication.
units.displayText: What a cursed past few days it's been; all the Entropics I've seen seem to be playing at sophistication.

spans.text: What a cursed past few days it's been; all the Entropics I've seen seem to be playing at sophistication.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>So long as we two are together, anywhere can be a fitting stage.</color>
units.displayText: So long as we two are together, anywhere can be a fitting stage.

spans.text: So long as we two are together, anywhere can be a fitting stage.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Give me your hand if you would. Let us have a little dance.</color>
units.displayText: Give me your hand if you would. Let us have a little dance.

spans.text: Give me your hand if you would. Let us have a little dance.

units.rawText:
...It feels like we aren't on the same wavelength.
Just cut to the chase: name your conditions for letting me off.
units.displayText:
...It feels like we aren't on the same wavelength.
Just cut to the chase: name your conditions for letting me off.

spans.text:
...It feels like we aren't on the same wavelength.
Just cut to the chase: name your conditions for letting me off.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>How impulsive you are... Why do you refuse to return to the fold? These children are all rather fond of you, you know.</color>
units.displayText: How impulsive you are... Why do you refuse to return to the fold? These children are all rather fond of you, you know.

spans.text: How impulsive you are... Why do you refuse to return to the fold? These children are all rather fond of you, you know.

units.rawText: Can you talk more normally? What the hell does return mean...
units.displayText: Can you talk more normally? What the hell does return mean...

spans.text: Can you talk more normally? What the hell does return mean...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>My friend of yesterday...</color>
units.displayText: My friend of yesterday...

spans.text: My friend of yesterday...

units.rawText: (It's almost impossible to communicate. This Entropic core really is important to her.)
units.displayText: It's almost impossible to communicate. This Entropic core really is important to her.

spans.text: It's almost impossible to communicate. This Entropic core really is important to her.

units.rawText: (If I can bargain my freedom in exchange for this core, it's a win-win.)
units.displayText: If I can bargain my freedom in exchange for this core, it's a win-win.

spans.text: If I can bargain my freedom in exchange for this core, it's a win-win.

units.rawText: (I win twice.)
units.displayText: I win twice.

spans.text: I win twice.

units.rawText: Rather than liking me, shouldn't it be this thing?
units.displayText: Rather than liking me, shouldn't it be this thing?

spans.text: Rather than liking me, shouldn't it be this thing?

units.rawText: Lind unfastens the cloth around her collarbones. In the center of her chest, a purple crystal was embedded, beating not unlike a living being. A set of purple veins branch out from within, the crystal acting as a core.
units.displayText: Lind unfastens the cloth around her collarbones. In the center of her chest, a purple crystal was embedded, beating not unlike a living being. A set of purple veins branch out from within, the crystal acting as a core.

spans.text: Lind unfastens the cloth around her collarbones. In the center of her chest, a purple crystal was embedded, beating not unlike a living being. A set of purple veins branch out from within, the crystal acting as a core.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Ah! Antenora!</color>
units.displayText: Ah! Antenora!

spans.text: Ah! Antenora!

units.rawText: Ptolemaea approaches Lind, carefully stroking the Entropic core. Reminiscence fills her countenance, and even Lind was briefly swayed.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea approaches Lind, carefully stroking the Entropic core. Reminiscence fills her countenance, and even Lind was briefly swayed.

spans.text: Ptolemaea approaches Lind, carefully stroking the Entropic core. Reminiscence fills her countenance, and even Lind was briefly swayed.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>So you were here all along. I looked for you for so long...</color>
units.displayText: So you were here all along. I looked for you for so long...

spans.text: So you were here all along. I looked for you for so long...

units.rawText: Not being consumed by this thing takes a great amount of effort, you know.
units.displayText: Not being consumed by this thing takes a great amount of effort, you know.

spans.text: Not being consumed by this thing takes a great amount of effort, you know.

units.rawText: This did not belong to me in the first place. If you want it, you can have it back.
units.displayText: This did not belong to me in the first place. If you want it, you can have it back.

spans.text: This did not belong to me in the first place. If you want it, you can have it back.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>But she already is yours. In other words... she is your heart.</color>
units.displayText: But she already is yours. In other words... she is your heart.

spans.text: But she already is yours. In other words... she is your heart.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea meets Lind's eyes. A tentacle of hers glides past the Entropic core, gesturing towards the Entropization inhibitor on her neck.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea meets Lind's eyes. A tentacle of hers glides past the Entropic core, gesturing towards the Entropization inhibitor on her neck.

spans.text: Ptolemaea meets Lind's eyes. A tentacle of hers glides past the Entropic core, gesturing towards the Entropization inhibitor on her neck.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Stop repressing yourself with these baubles. Your heart beseeches you to return to the fold, does it not?</color>
units.displayText: Stop repressing yourself with these baubles. Your heart beseeches you to return to the fold, does it not?

spans.text: Stop repressing yourself with these baubles. Your heart beseeches you to return to the fold, does it not?

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>You are our kin, so return to us...</color>
units.displayText: You are our kin, so return to us...

spans.text: You are our kin, so return to us...

units.rawText: You're only after this core, aren't you? Why do you insist on turning me into your "kin"?
units.displayText: You're only after this core, aren't you? Why do you insist on turning me into your "kin"?

spans.text: You're only after this core, aren't you? Why do you insist on turning me into your "kin"?

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>That child often speaks of you. I ought to think she looks forward to your reunion.</color>
units.displayText: That child often speaks of you. I ought to think she looks forward to your reunion.

spans.text: That child often speaks of you. I ought to think she looks forward to your reunion.

units.rawText: What are you saying... just who is "that child"?
units.displayText: What are you saying... just who is "that child"?

spans.text: What are you saying... just who is "that child"?

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>A surprise, meticulously prepared, loses its charm if revealed ahead of time, does it not?</color>
units.displayText: A surprise, meticulously prepared, loses its charm if revealed ahead of time, does it not?

spans.text: A surprise, meticulously prepared, loses its charm if revealed ahead of time, does it not?

units.rawText: Do you know how to speak languages other than schlock? Let me show you what a simple and concise reply looks like.
units.displayText: Do you know how to speak languages other than schlock? Let me show you what a simple and concise reply looks like.

spans.text: Do you know how to speak languages other than schlock? Let me show you what a simple and concise reply looks like.

units.rawText: Lind takes a singular step back as the light slipping through the building's marred exterior spills onto her.
units.displayText: Lind takes a singular step back as the light slipping through the building's marred exterior spills onto her.

spans.text: Lind takes a singular step back as the light slipping through the building's marred exterior spills onto her.

units.rawText: I am no kin of yours. I will not allow myself to be Entropized.
units.displayText: I am no kin of yours. I will not allow myself to be Entropized.

spans.text: I am no kin of yours. I will not allow myself to be Entropized.

units.rawText: I am a Guardian. "Guardians, who lift each other up in this forgotten world, so we may live on."
units.displayText: I am a Guardian. "Guardians, who lift each other up in this forgotten world, so we may live on."

spans.text: I am a Guardian. "Guardians, who lift each other up in this forgotten world, so we may live on."

units.rawText: I have places I need to go back to, people I need to see, things I need to do.
units.displayText: I have places I need to go back to, people I need to see, things I need to do.

spans.text: I have places I need to go back to, people I need to see, things I need to do.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea sighs, creating distance between her and Lind once more.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea sighs, creating distance between her and Lind once more.

spans.text: Ptolemaea sighs, creating distance between her and Lind once more.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>I had intended to converse with you for a little longer, but... time grows short.</color>
units.displayText: I had intended to converse with you for a little longer, but... time grows short.

spans.text: I had intended to converse with you for a little longer, but... time grows short.

units.rawText: Fssh!
units.displayText: Fssh!

spans.text: Fssh!

units.rawText: The flowing air arrives before the tentacle. Lind's already on-end nerves pull her out of the attack's way immediately, and the other tentacles she intercepts with her mechanical arms.
units.displayText: The flowing air arrives before the tentacle. Lind's already on-end nerves pull her out of the attack's way immediately, and the other tentacles she intercepts with her mechanical arms.

spans.text: The flowing air arrives before the tentacle. Lind's already on-end nerves pull her out of the attack's way immediately, and the other tentacles she intercepts with her mechanical arms.

units.rawText: Whew... not nice to just start using violence. You...
units.displayText: Whew... not nice to just start using violence. You...

spans.text: Whew... not nice to just start using violence. You...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Over here.</color>
units.displayText: Over here.

spans.text: Over here.

units.rawText: Overwhelming speed blows away every measure Lind prepared for the engagement. Ptolemaea materializes from the shadows behind Lind. Before the latter could respond, a tentacle constricts around her waist.
units.displayText: Overwhelming speed blows away every measure Lind prepared for the engagement. Ptolemaea materializes from the shadows behind Lind. Before the latter could respond, a tentacle constricts around her waist.

spans.text: Overwhelming speed blows away every measure Lind prepared for the engagement. Ptolemaea materializes from the shadows behind Lind. Before the latter could respond, a tentacle constricts around her waist.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Seeing as that child made a point of it, I will do my best to be gentle... Although I should think that it will still hurt.</color>
units.displayText: Seeing as that child made a point of it, I will do my best to be gentle... Although I should think that it will still hurt.

spans.text: Seeing as that child made a point of it, I will do my best to be gentle... Although I should think that it will still hurt.

units.rawText: Several tentacles attach themselves to the core, and it soon becomes a scorching heat in Lind's chest. The rest of her body begins to melt away, along with her pain nerves.
units.displayText: Several tentacles attach themselves to the core, and it soon becomes a scorching heat in Lind's chest. The rest of her body begins to melt away, along with her pain nerves.

spans.text: Several tentacles attach themselves to the core, and it soon becomes a scorching heat in Lind's chest. The rest of her body begins to melt away, along with her pain nerves.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>It'll be alright, bear with me, a little longer...</color>
units.displayText: It'll be alright, bear with me, a little longer...

spans.text: It'll be alright, bear with me, a little longer...

units.rawText: Gah...<color=red><size=60>AHHHHH!!!</size></color>
units.displayText: Gah...AHHHHH!!!

spans.text: Gah...
AHHHHH!!!

units.rawText: A pain analogous to the ripping out of one's heart fills her neural cloud, overrunning all her remaining thoughts. Her pained cries drown out Ptolemaea's voice.
units.displayText: A pain analogous to the ripping out of one's heart fills her neural cloud, overrunning all her remaining thoughts. Her pained cries drown out Ptolemaea's voice.

spans.text: A pain analogous to the ripping out of one's heart fills her neural cloud, overrunning all her remaining thoughts. Her pained cries drown out Ptolemaea's voice.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>It will all be over soon...</color>
units.displayText: It will all be over soon...

spans.text: It will all be over soon...

units.rawText: Ptolemaea glances in the direction of the Oasis through the cracks in the wall.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea glances in the direction of the Oasis through the cracks in the wall.

spans.text: Ptolemaea glances in the direction of the Oasis through the cracks in the wall.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>I pray that the dance will save a spot for me when the time comes...</color>
units.displayText: I pray that the dance will save a spot for me when the time comes...

spans.text: I pray that the dance will save a spot for me when the time comes...

units.rawText: The Oasis, Zone G Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Zone G Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: The Oasis, Zone G Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: And with that, basic repairs are more or less complete. Next is additional reinforcements...
units.displayText: And with that, basic repairs are more or less complete. Next is additional reinforcements...

spans.text: And with that, basic repairs are more or less complete. Next is additional reinforcements...

units.rawText: Anna!
units.displayText: Anna!

spans.text: Anna!

units.rawText: Sol? What are you doing here instead of recovering properly? And with a different projection too...
units.displayText: Sol? What are you doing here instead of recovering properly? And with a different projection too...

spans.text: Sol? What are you doing here instead of recovering properly? And with a different projection too...

units.rawText: Hehe, how's it look? The expeditionary gear fits me well, doesn't it?
units.displayText: Hehe, how's it look? The expeditionary gear fits me well, doesn't it?

spans.text: Hehe, how's it look? The expeditionary gear fits me well, doesn't it?

units.rawText: We were in such a rush on the way to Rossum last time that I didn't get to change. Can't let Persicaria get away with being the only one with new clothes...
units.displayText: We were in such a rush on the way to Rossum last time that I didn't get to change. Can't let Persicaria get away with being the only one with new clothes...

spans.text: We were in such a rush on the way to Rossum last time that I didn't get to change. Can't let Persicaria get away with being the only one with new clothes...

units.rawText: Wait, wait, wait, the projection isn't the important thing here. Are your wounds okay?
units.displayText: Wait, wait, wait, the projection isn't the important thing here. Are your wounds okay?

spans.text: Wait, wait, wait, the projection isn't the important thing here. Are your wounds okay?

units.rawText: Uhh... Hey, Magnhilda! What're you up to? Lemme have a look!
units.displayText: Uhh... Hey, Magnhilda! What're you up to? Lemme have a look!

spans.text: Uhh... Hey, Magnhilda! What're you up to? Lemme have a look!

units.rawText: Hold it! Did you sneak out of the Medical Department?
units.displayText: Hold it! Did you sneak out of the Medical Department?

spans.text: Hold it! Did you sneak out of the Medical Department?

units.rawText: Anna~ the Oasis isn't out of danger just yet. How am I going to just lie there?
units.displayText: Anna~ the Oasis isn't out of danger just yet. How am I going to just lie there?

spans.text: Anna~ the Oasis isn't out of danger just yet. How am I going to just lie there?

units.rawText: And I'm perfectly okay now! You see, it doesn't hurt one bit...
units.displayText: And I'm perfectly okay now! You see, it doesn't hurt one bit...

spans.text: And I'm perfectly okay now! You see, it doesn't hurt one bit...

units.rawText: A real intellectual would properly consider their own damn safety!
units.displayText: A real intellectual would properly consider their own damn safety!

spans.text: A real intellectual would properly consider their own damn safety!

units.rawText: Okay, okay, I get it—
units.displayText: Okay, okay, I get it—

spans.text: Okay, okay, I get it—

units.rawText: Wait, Anna! A bunch of the symbols on your screen are turning red!
units.displayText: Wait, Anna! A bunch of the symbols on your screen are turning red!

spans.text: Wait, Anna! A bunch of the symbols on your screen are turning red!

units.rawText: If anything did come up, there'd be an alert! You claim to be an intellectual with this shoddy of an excuse—
units.displayText: If anything did come up, there'd be an alert! You claim to be an intellectual with this shoddy of an excuse—

spans.text: If anything did come up, there'd be an alert! You claim to be an intellectual with this shoddy of an excuse—

units.rawText: Beeeeep—Before Antonina finishes her sentence, her terminal bursts into activity as if to verify Sol's claim.
units.displayText: Beeeeep—Before Antonina finishes her sentence, her terminal bursts into activity as if to verify Sol's claim.

spans.text: Beeeeep—Before Antonina finishes her sentence, her terminal bursts into activity as if to verify Sol's claim.

units.rawText: A-A-Antonina! We're in trouble!
units.displayText: A-A-Antonina! We're in trouble!

spans.text: A-A-Antonina! We're in trouble!

units.rawText: What is it, Mai? Slow down a bit.
units.displayText: What is it, Mai? Slow down a bit.

spans.text: What is it, Mai? Slow down a bit.

units.rawText: I-I can't slow down! All of our defense and reconnaissance structures outside the Sandbox Barrier have been destroyed!
units.displayText: I-I can't slow down! All of our defense and reconnaissance structures outside the Sandbox Barrier have been destroyed!

spans.text: I-I can't slow down! All of our defense and reconnaissance structures outside the Sandbox Barrier have been destroyed!

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: Antonina looks at her terminal. The defense nodes outside Zone G successively light up in red as they detect danger—and are pulverized the moment after, before they even manage to send out an alarm.
units.displayText: Antonina looks at her terminal. The defense nodes outside Zone G successively light up in red as they detect danger—and are pulverized the moment after, before they even manage to send out an alarm.

spans.text: Antonina looks at her terminal. The defense nodes outside Zone G successively light up in red as they detect danger—and are pulverized the moment after, before they even manage to send out an alarm.

units.rawText: I was saying...
units.displayText: I was saying...

spans.text: I was saying...

units.rawText: So it was serious... A highly dangerous abnormal data body is approaching the defense lines. Go contact Persicaria!
units.displayText: So it was serious... A highly dangerous abnormal data body is approaching the defense lines. Go contact Persicaria!

spans.text: So it was serious... A highly dangerous abnormal data body is approaching the defense lines. Go contact Persicaria!

units.rawText: I've already sent everything through to the Ops Room!
units.displayText: I've already sent everything through to the Ops Room!

spans.text: I've already sent everything through to the Ops Room!

units.rawText: I'm going outside the barrier to reinforce Magnhilda!
units.displayText: I'm going outside the barrier to reinforce Magnhilda!

spans.text: I'm going outside the barrier to reinforce Magnhilda!

units.rawText: Sol!
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Antonina watches as Sol begins to step away, blade in hand. She had something to say, but swallows them before they slip out of her.
units.displayText: Antonina watches as Sol begins to step away, blade in hand. She had something to say, but swallows them before they slip out of her.

spans.text: Antonina watches as Sol begins to step away, blade in hand. She had something to say, but swallows them before they slip out of her.

units.rawText: ...Keep in touch.
units.displayText: ...Keep in touch.

spans.text: ...Keep in touch.

units.rawText: Alright!
units.displayText: Alright!

spans.text: Alright!

units.rawText: The Oasis, outside of Zone G's Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: The Oasis, outside of Zone G's Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: The Oasis, outside of Zone G's Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: Replenish your munitions, everyone! Get ready for the next wave!
units.displayText: Replenish your munitions, everyone! Get ready for the next wave!

spans.text: Replenish your munitions, everyone! Get ready for the next wave!

units.rawText: Damn, these Entropics were like the middle of a mosh pit just then. How are they so organized all of a sudden? Have the reconnaissance nodes sent back anything relevant for us?
units.displayText: Damn, these Entropics were like the middle of a mosh pit just then. How are they so organized all of a sudden? Have the reconnaissance nodes sent back anything relevant for us?

spans.text: Damn, these Entropics were like the middle of a mosh pit just then. How are they so organized all of a sudden? Have the reconnaissance nodes sent back anything relevant for us?

units.rawText: No, they were destroyed before they could do even that...
units.displayText: No, they were destroyed before they could do even that...

spans.text: No, they were destroyed before they could do even that...

units.rawText: Incoming from two o'clock, and all obstructions in the way have already been removed... I'll reinforce the defense nodes on the path further along. They must at least return imaging data.
units.displayText: Incoming from two o'clock, and all obstructions in the way have already been removed... I'll reinforce the defense nodes on the path further along. They must at least return imaging data.

spans.text: Incoming from two o'clock, and all obstructions in the way have already been removed... I'll reinforce the defense nodes on the path further along. They must at least return imaging data.

units.rawText: These Entropics are bound to be under the control of a newly arrived foe to structure an offense like this. Mai, I'll have to ask you to continue your tracking efforts.
units.displayText: These Entropics are bound to be under the control of a newly arrived foe to structure an offense like this. Mai, I'll have to ask you to continue your tracking efforts.

spans.text: These Entropics are bound to be under the control of a newly arrived foe to structure an offense like this. Mai, I'll have to ask you to continue your tracking efforts.

units.rawText: Okay!
units.displayText: Okay!

spans.text: Okay!

units.rawText: Ah, Persicaria!
units.displayText: Ah, Persicaria!

spans.text: Ah, Persicaria!

units.rawText: I've received your report. Our opponent is likely far stronger than any foe we've previously met.
units.displayText: I've received your report. Our opponent is likely far stronger than any foe we've previously met.

spans.text: I've received your report. Our opponent is likely far stronger than any foe we've previously met.

units.rawText: I've sent reinforcements your way. Immediately retreat to the Sandbox Barrier and prepare to defend.
units.displayText: I've sent reinforcements your way. Immediately retreat to the Sandbox Barrier and prepare to defend.

spans.text: I've sent reinforcements your way. Immediately retreat to the Sandbox Barrier and prepare to defend.

units.rawText: You mean that we should abandon the defensive nodes outside the Oasis?
units.displayText: You mean that we should abandon the defensive nodes outside the Oasis?

spans.text: You mean that we should abandon the defensive nodes outside the Oasis?

units.rawText: Judging by how quickly they were destroyed, I doubt we will be able to use them as defensive positions.
units.displayText: Judging by how quickly they were destroyed, I doubt we will be able to use them as defensive positions.

spans.text: Judging by how quickly they were destroyed, I doubt we will be able to use them as defensive positions.

units.rawText: Retreat as soon as you are able. With the speed at which the enemy approaches, we have little time left.
units.displayText: Retreat as soon as you are able. With the speed at which the enemy approaches, we have little time left.

spans.text: Retreat as soon as you are able. With the speed at which the enemy approaches, we have little time left.

units.rawText: Tch... Alright, I'll inform everyone.
units.displayText: Tch... Alright, I'll inform everyone.

spans.text: Tch... Alright, I'll inform everyone.

units.rawText: Wait, reconnaissance node 3 is sending back imaging. I'll patch it in...
units.displayText: Wait, reconnaissance node 3 is sending back imaging. I'll patch it in...

spans.text: Wait, reconnaissance node 3 is sending back imaging. I'll patch it in...

units.rawText: After a brief period of static, the screen displays a feed of the Null Area. The feed remains peaceful for a period as if nothing had happened.
units.displayText: After a brief period of static, the screen displays a feed of the Null Area. The feed remains peaceful for a period as if nothing had happened.

spans.text: After a brief period of static, the screen displays a feed of the Null Area. The feed remains peaceful for a period as if nothing had happened.

units.rawText: Hmm, the system detected abnormalities just then. Could it be an error?
units.displayText: Hmm, the system detected abnormalities just then. Could it be an error?

spans.text: Hmm, the system detected abnormalities just then. Could it be an error?

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Accept unto yourself this decadent affection, and let come what fate decides...</color>
units.displayText: Accept unto yourself this decadent affection, and let come what fate decides...

spans.text: Accept unto yourself this decadent affection, and let come what fate decides...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>As the beat dictates, we deliver our most splendid dance...</color>
units.displayText: As the beat dictates, we deliver our most splendid dance...

spans.text: As the beat dictates, we deliver our most splendid dance...

units.rawText: The feed remains unchanging, but the airy sound of singing came through loud and clear.
units.displayText: The feed remains unchanging, but the airy sound of singing came through loud and clear.

spans.text: The feed remains unchanging, but the airy sound of singing came through loud and clear.

units.rawText: Eep, it's that singing again... Scary...
units.displayText: Eep, it's that singing again... Scary...

spans.text: Eep, it's that singing again... Scary...

units.rawText: No, wait, this sound is far clearer than before...
units.displayText: No, wait, this sound is far clearer than before...

spans.text: No, wait, this sound is far clearer than before...

units.rawText: Persicaria, reconnaissance node 1 is returning a feed!
units.displayText: Persicaria, reconnaissance node 1 is returning a feed!

spans.text: Persicaria, reconnaissance node 1 is returning a feed!

units.rawText: Wait, node 2 and 4 as well... All of them, just out of the blue...
units.displayText: Wait, node 2 and 4 as well... All of them, just out of the blue...

spans.text: Wait, node 2 and 4 as well... All of them, just out of the blue...

units.rawText: Our equipment's been hacked! Reject the incoming feed!
units.displayText: Our equipment's been hacked! Reject the incoming feed!

spans.text: Our equipment's been hacked! Reject the incoming feed!

units.rawText: Rejection failed!
units.displayText: Rejection failed!

spans.text: Rejection failed!

units.rawText: In countless feeds, the song resonates, orchestrating this grand ball's overture.
units.displayText: In countless feeds, the song resonates, orchestrating this grand ball's overture.

spans.text: In countless feeds, the song resonates, orchestrating this grand ball's overture.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Come! Come! Sing with us!</color>
units.displayText: Come! Come! Sing with us!

spans.text: Come! Come! Sing with us!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Come! Come! Dance with us!</color>
units.displayText: Come! Come! Dance with us!

spans.text: Come! Come! Dance with us!

units.rawText: The feed from the node is gradually filled with purple.
units.displayText: The feed from the node is gradually filled with purple.

spans.text: The feed from the node is gradually filled with purple.

units.rawText: No good. Force cut the connection with the nodes!
units.displayText: No good. Force cut the connection with the nodes!

spans.text: No good. Force cut the connection with the nodes!

units.rawText: Understood!
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: As the link is forcibly closed, the chorus gradually thins down to a solo. Only node 3 still remained, the first to exhibit this phenomenon, its feed still calm and pristine.
units.displayText: As the link is forcibly closed, the chorus gradually thins down to a solo. Only node 3 still remained, the first to exhibit this phenomenon, its feed still calm and pristine.

spans.text: As the link is forcibly closed, the chorus gradually thins down to a solo. Only node 3 still remained, the first to exhibit this phenomenon, its feed still calm and pristine.

units.rawText: Bzzt.
units.displayText: Bzzt.

spans.text: Bzzt.

units.rawText: Suddenly, the feed blinks briefly. Streaks of purple liquid begin to creep in from the edges as a familiar shape appears.
units.displayText: Suddenly, the feed blinks briefly. Streaks of purple liquid begin to creep in from the edges as a familiar shape appears.

spans.text: Suddenly, the feed blinks briefly. Streaks of purple liquid begin to creep in from the edges as a familiar shape appears.

units.rawText: Those are... the Entropic jellyfish? One, two... no, this number...
units.displayText: Those are... the Entropic jellyfish? One, two... no, this number...

spans.text: Those are... the Entropic jellyfish? One, two... no, this number...

units.rawText: The Entropic jellyfish, having discovered the node, returns to its tribe. Enveloped by countless Entropic jellyfish, the core of the Entropic swarm gradually reveals its form.
units.displayText: The Entropic jellyfish, having discovered the node, returns to its tribe. Enveloped by countless Entropic jellyfish, the core of the Entropic swarm gradually reveals its form.

spans.text: The Entropic jellyfish, having discovered the node, returns to its tribe. Enveloped by countless Entropic jellyfish, the core of the Entropic swarm gradually reveals its form.

units.rawText: She treads lightly, pivoting, striding, as though she was this performance's lead dancer.
units.displayText: She treads lightly, pivoting, striding, as though she was this performance's lead dancer.

spans.text: She treads lightly, pivoting, striding, as though she was this performance's lead dancer.

units.rawText: Taking note of the Entropic jellyfish's discovery, she lightly caresses its bell with a tentacle of hers.
units.displayText: Taking note of the Entropic jellyfish's discovery, she lightly caresses its bell with a tentacle of hers.

spans.text: Taking note of the Entropic jellyfish's discovery, she lightly caresses its bell with a tentacle of hers.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Well, it seems I've missed one. How clumsy of me. Thankfully, you've spotted it.</color>
units.displayText: Well, it seems I've missed one. How clumsy of me. Thankfully, you've spotted it.

spans.text: Well, it seems I've missed one. How clumsy of me. Thankfully, you've spotted it.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>No great matter. Let us think of it as an invitation to the dance. It will no doubt make the show spectacular beyond compare.</color>
units.displayText: No great matter. Let us think of it as an invitation to the dance. It will no doubt make the show spectacular beyond compare.

spans.text: No great matter. Let us think of it as an invitation to the dance. It will no doubt make the show spectacular beyond compare.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hehe, a stage different from Tartarus...</color>
units.displayText: Hehe, a stage different from Tartarus...

spans.text: Hehe, a stage different from Tartarus...

units.rawText: As she speaks with grace and tenderness, she turns her attention to the camera. Everyone in front of the screen had no choice but to increase their operational speed, struggling to remove their sight from that figure.
units.displayText: As she speaks with grace and tenderness, she turns her attention to the camera. Everyone in front of the screen had no choice but to increase their operational speed, struggling to remove their sight from that figure.

spans.text: As she speaks with grace and tenderness, she turns her attention to the camera. Everyone in front of the screen had no choice but to increase their operational speed, struggling to remove their sight from that figure.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Let the dance... begin.</color>
units.displayText: Let the dance... begin.

spans.text: Let the dance... begin.

units.rawText: The feed soon becomes submerged in pitch black, and the icon depicting reconnaissance node 3 on the map becomes gray. At the same time, a faint tremor came from the distance.
units.displayText: The feed soon becomes submerged in pitch black, and the icon depicting reconnaissance node 3 on the map becomes gray. At the same time, a faint tremor came from the distance.

spans.text: The feed soon becomes submerged in pitch black, and the icon depicting reconnaissance node 3 on the map becomes gray. At the same time, a faint tremor came from the distance.

units.rawText: Entropic swarm, rapidly approaching!
units.displayText: Entropic swarm, rapidly approaching!

spans.text: Entropic swarm, rapidly approaching!

units.rawText: Immediately retreat! Squad Magnhilda, coordinate a fighting retreat with Squad Horizon. Antonina will meet up with you!
units.displayText: Immediately retreat! Squad Magnhilda, coordinate a fighting retreat with Squad Horizon. Antonina will meet up with you!

spans.text: Immediately retreat! Squad Magnhilda, coordinate a fighting retreat with Squad Horizon. Antonina will meet up with you!

units.rawText: Understood! Where are our reinforcements?
units.displayText: Understood! Where are our reinforcements?

spans.text: Understood! Where are our reinforcements?

units.rawText: Over here!
units.displayText: Over here!

spans.text: Over here!

units.rawText: A familiar golden mane appears at their side.
units.displayText: A familiar golden mane appears at their side.

spans.text: A familiar golden mane appears at their side.

units.rawText: Sol?! Weren't you recovering at...
units.displayText: Sol?! Weren't you recovering at...

spans.text: Sol?! Weren't you recovering at...

units.rawText: Let me command the reinforcements you've sent. This'll be one hell of a battle, so don't think I will be missing out!
units.displayText: Let me command the reinforcements you've sent. This'll be one hell of a battle, so don't think I will be missing out!

spans.text: Let me command the reinforcements you've sent. This'll be one hell of a battle, so don't think I will be missing out!

units.rawText: ...I'll leave it to you then. If something seems off, immediately retreat. Do not fixate on holding every line you can.
units.displayText: ...I'll leave it to you then. If something seems off, immediately retreat. Do not fixate on holding every line you can.

spans.text: ...I'll leave it to you then. If something seems off, immediately retreat. Do not fixate on holding every line you can.

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Don't hit my head anymore! This is the head of an intellectual, I tell you!
units.displayText: Don't hit my head anymore! This is the head of an intellectual, I tell you!

spans.text: Don't hit my head anymore! This is the head of an intellectual, I tell you!
